_doc: Divergence bands for the served-metric monitor (eval/served_monitor.py). Bands are deliberately wide: a served rate outside its band means the live system no longer behaves like the eval cohorts (corpus drift, a serving-path bug, or a prompt/verifier change that never went through the harness) and must be investigated, not tuned away. Eval anchors: criterion abstention 0.5558-0.6092 (TREC v5/v4, phase9v5_exclusion_grounding.md), 0.593 across the full analyst cache; unverifiable 0.0276-0.0471 across cohorts and pool depths (e1b_findings.md, h1_pool_curve_trec2021.md). min_trials guards against judging drift off a handful of requests.
